caption: The drawing is a square pattern composed of small, repetitive diamond-shaped elements arranged on a flat background. The primary colors in the illustration are red and blue. The blue serves as the background color, with evenly spaced and small red diamond shapes filling the space. Over this, larger red geometric forms are constructed, including parallel bands of diamonds that create an octagonal, concentric framework centered in the square. Squares made of red diamonds are present at the corners and at intervals along these bands. Overall, the composition is symmetrical and appears woven or embroidered, with the red elements forming a repeated, step-like pattern around a central, empty blue square. The pattern is contained within a blue square on a larger blank, off-white rectangular sheet, and there is a small, cursive signature reading "Cristoffels" near the lower right edge of the design.
title: Coverlet - Section of Reverse Side
